name: agentforce-accelerator-factory
description: Factory skills for Agentforce agents: draft a knowledge profile from a domain pack (what answers depend on, which source wins, what must be refused) and check source files before upload, choose the building block (no agent, a standard FAQ agent, a prompt template or a custom agent), check an org and its Knowledge, scope and license an agent engagement, design and ground an agent with a bake-off of Salesforce's documented method against alternatives on one test library, author it in Agent Script, publish and test it in Testing Center, keep an accuracy scorecard by layer with a release threshold, and run Agent Ops after every Salesforce release. Also: contact center call intelligence on Salesforce Voice (calls that log themselves with a wrap-up, sentiment and QA) case documentation and routing on Service Cloud; an after-hours and level-1 voice line for calls a NICE CXone or Webex contact center hands over; and member status from several systems through Data 360, with a fit check first. Builds on Salesforce's own agentforce-generate and agentforce-test skills.
